_comment: CATASTROPHIC-STOP calibration. CatStopATRMult>0 turns on the always-on backstop (PurchasePrice - CatStopATRMult×EntryATR) AND anchors risk-based position sizing, so run with -risk-pct 1 to size positions off the stop. Includes 0 so the grid can also confirm whether running without a catastrophic stop wins. go run ./cmd/backtest -ticker ASTR -strategy reversion -interval Hour1 -calibrate data/params/astr/reversion_cal_catstop.json -out ./reports/ASTR_catstop -months 31 -train-months 12 -test-months 6 -metric profit_factor -min-trades 20 -risk-pct 1
